exchangeRates.title: Exchange rates
exchangeRates.description: Your company's exchange rates, currency conversion and period-end FX revaluation
exchangeRates.fxBasis: Outstanding balances of posted foreign-currency invoices, vendor bills and linked bank accounts, remeasured at the closing rate (spot when no closing rate exists). Drafts are excluded.
exchangeRates.noExposure: No open foreign-currency exposures for the selected as-of date.
exchangeRates.converterDesc: Convert amounts using your company's rates (system rates as fallback)
exchangeRates.savedRatesDesc: Company rates apply only to this company. System rates are platform reference rates (for example FTA-published) used when the company has none.
exchangeRates.noRatesHint: Add your first rate to get started.
exchangeRates.staleBannerTitle: Some exchange rates are out of date
exchangeRates.staleBannerBody: These pairs have no rate in the last {days} days. Documents and revaluations will warn until a newer rate is added:
exchangeRates.feedOffBody: AED to USD uses the fixed peg. Add rates for other currencies here.
exchangeRates.rewrittenHint: Stored inverted by an earlier version; corrected by migration
exchangeRates.addDesc: Rates are stored as units of your base currency per 1 unit of the foreign currency.
exchangeRates.revalDesc: Posts one balanced unrealised FX entry dated the as-of date and an automatic reversal dated the next day. Running the same date twice does nothing.
exchangeRates.nothingToPost: Nothing to revalue on this date.
exchangeRates.alreadyPosted: A revaluation is already posted for this date.
exchangeRates.bandTitle: A rate is far from the reference rate
exchangeRates.bandReasonHint: Owner, admin, accountant or CFO only. The reason is kept with the revaluation and in the audit log.
exchangeRates.exportEmptyDesc: FX Gains and Losses is still loading or has no rows to export.
exchangeRates.exportedDesc: FX Gains and Losses has been downloaded.
exchangeRates.warnFallback: No {kind} rate for {from}/{to}; the spot rate was used.
exchangeRates.warnMissing: No {from}→{to} exchange rate on or before {date}
exchangeRates.warnStale: Rate {from}/{to} is {age} days old (dated {date}); the proximity limit is {limit} days.
exchangeRates.searchPlaceholder: Search by currency, type or source
exchangeRates.noMatch: No saved rates match your search.
exchangeRates.loadFailedBody: Your saved rates are unchanged. Check your connection and try again.
exchangeRates.fxLoadFailedBody: The exposure figures could not be loaded, so none are shown. Try again.
exchangeRates.refreshFailedBody: Showing the last rates that loaded. They may be out of date.
exchangeRates.fxRefreshFailedBody: Showing the last figures that loaded. They may be out of date, so export is turned off until they refresh.
exchangeRates.refreshPausedBody: Showing the last rates that loaded. Refresh will resume automatically.
exchangeRates.fxRefreshPausedBody: Showing the last figures that loaded. Refresh will resume automatically, and export is turned off until then.
